胡九郎避开了范梦雪的追问,他既不愿对小师妹袒露心底的酸涩与疑惑，也无法给自己一个合理的解释——他与杨童不过两面之缘，这份突如其来的幻境，还有那逼真的背叛，实在太过蹊跷。

范梦雪看着他紧绷的侧脸，眼底满是担忧，却也识趣地没有再追问，只是轻轻点了点头，继续在阴尘阁内搜寻。

阴尘阁不大，陈设简单却诡异，四处都弥漫着阴冷的气息，桌上的药材大多是阴邪之物，符文卷轴上的字迹扭曲怪异，透着一股不祥。

两人小心翼翼地翻找着，胡九郎多少有些心神不宁，还是强迫自己集中精神。

“师兄，你看这里！”

范梦雪的声音突然响起，带着一丝惊喜。

胡九郎连忙走过去，只见她站在阁楼最深处的一个黑色柜子前，柜子上挂着一把铜锁，铜锁上缠绕着淡淡的黑气，显然是被邪术封印过。

柜子缝隙中，隐隐透出一股幽冷的气息，与他印象中玄阴石的气息一模一样。

“应该就是这里了。”

胡九郎眼底闪过一丝光亮，指尖捻起朱砂，轻轻点在铜锁上，口中念起破封咒语。

朱砂瞬间燃起金光，金光包裹住铜锁，缠绕在铜锁上的黑气发出“滋滋”的声响，渐渐消散。

片刻后，“咔哒”一声，铜锁应声而开。

范梦雪轻轻拉开柜门，只见柜子内铺着黑色的绒布，绒布中央，静静躺着一块拳头大小的黑色石块，石块表面光滑，隐隐泛着幽蓝的光泽，周身萦绕着淡淡的阴冷气息，正是他们苦苦寻找的玄阴石。

“找到了！”

范梦雪伸手想要去拿，却被胡九郎拦住。

胡九郎神色凝重，指尖轻轻拂过玄阴石表面，没有出现任何异常，那股幽冷的气息依旧纯粹，没有掺杂其他阴邪之气。

胡九郎这才松了口气，伸手将玄阴石拿起，入手冰凉，一股阴冷的气息顺着指尖渗入体内。

胡九郎将玄阴石小心翼翼地放进随身的锦盒里，盖好盖子，又在锦盒外贴了一张驱邪符，防止玄阴石的阴气外泄，两人快步朝着阴尘阁门外走去。

Hu Jiulang avoided Fan Mengxue's questioning. He did not want to reveal his inner sorrow and doubts to his junior sister, nor could he give himself a reasonable explanation - he and Yang Tong were just two-way friends. This sudden illusion and the realistic betrayal were really too strange.

Fan Mengxue looked at his tense side face, her eyes full of worry, but she wisely did not ask any more questions. She just nodded lightly and continued to search the Yinchen Pavilion.

The Yinchen Pavilion is small, the furnishings are simple but weird, and there is a cold atmosphere everywhere. Most of the medicinal materials on the table are evil things, and the handwriting on the rune scroll is twisted and weird, with an ominous atmosphere.

The two of them rummaged carefully. Hu Jiulang was somewhat uneasy, but he forced himself to concentrate.

"Brother, look here!"

Fan Mengxue's voice suddenly sounded, with a hint of surprise.

Hu Jiulang hurriedly walked over and saw her standing in front of a black cabinet in the deepest part of the attic. There was a copper lock hanging on the cabinet. The copper lock was wrapped with a faint black aura, which was obviously sealed by evil magic.

There was a faint cold breath coming from the gap in the cabinet, which was exactly the same as the breath of Xuanyin Stone in his impression.

"It should be right here."

A glimmer of light flashed in Hu Jiulang's eyes, he twisted cinnabar with his fingertips, lightly tapped on the copper lock, and recited the spell to break the seal.

The cinnabar instantly ignited with golden light, and the golden light wrapped around the copper lock. The black air wrapped around the copper lock made a "sizzling" sound and gradually dissipated.

After a moment, there was a "click" and the copper lock opened.

Fan Mengxue gently opened the cabinet door and saw that the cabinet was covered with black velvet cloth. In the center of the velvet cloth, lying quietly was a fist-sized black stone. The surface of the stone was smooth, with a faint blue sheen, and a faint cold aura lingering around it. It was the Xuanyin Stone they were looking for.

"Found it!"

Fan Mengxue reached out to take it, but was stopped by Hu Jiulang.

Hu Jiulang's expression was solemn, and his fingertips gently brushed the surface of Xuanyin Stone. There was no abnormality. The cold aura was still pure and not mixed with other evil spirits.

Hu Jiulang breathed a sigh of relief and reached out to pick up the Xuanyin Stone. His hands were cold, and a cold breath seeped into his body along his fingertips.

Hu Jiulang carefully put the Xuanyin Stone into the brocade box he carried with him, closed the lid, and put an exorcism charm on the outside of the brocade box to prevent the Yin Qi of the Xuanyin Stone from leaking out. The two of them walked quickly towards the door of Yinchen Pavilion.
